# Salesforce Releases Page — captured 2026-07-07

## Note
Direct fetch of https://www.salesforce.com/releases/ returned HTTP 403 on 2026-07-07
(consistent with 07-06, 07-04, 07-03, 06-16, and earlier). salesforce.com/news/* also
403s. Content below sourced via WebSearch fallback.

## NEW (announced ~2026-07-06, since last cache) [REPORTED 2026-07-07]
- Agentforce Commerce — GENERALLY AVAILABLE (July 6 2026). Three production agents:
  * Shopper Agent (B2C): carries customer from discovery through checkout into service
    on the storefront, in the brand's voice.
  * Buyer Agent (B2B): orchestrates B2B orders over WhatsApp / SMS, no portal login.
  * Merchant Agent: back-office — catalog organization, product sorting, promotions,
    responds to trends in plain language.
  * Native integration into ChatGPT (OpenAI, GA July 2026 — sync product catalog to
    ChatGPT from Business Manager, no custom dev), and Google Search incl. AI Mode +
    Gemini app (arriving summer 2026). Spans B2C, B2B, Order Management, Point of Sale.
- Agentforce Help Agent — GA July '26. Autonomous service agent, guided setup,
  deployable in minutes across voice, web, portal, messaging from a single screen.
  Pay-per-resolution pricing (charged only on autonomous end-to-end resolution).
- Agentforce Customer Service Portal — GA July '26. Reimagined self-service experience;
  adapts in real time, dynamic cards, individualized responses.

## Prior (Summer '26 — "Agentic Enterprise", ~June 2026) [REPORTED 2026-07-06]
- Multi-Agent Orchestration — GA Jun 15 2026. Primary agent coordinates specialized
  subagents, shared context, routes to best-fit specialist. Atlas Reasoning Engine 3.0.
- Agent2Agent (A2A) open protocol — delegate to third-party agents on other platforms.
- Agent Script + new Agentforce Builder — GA.
- "Create Agent" element in Flow Builder — build/deploy on flow canvas; legacy actions auto-convert.
- IT Service Domain Pack — 50+ prebuilt AI agents for Slack, Teams, IT Service Desk.
- Agentforce Sales in Slack — proactive prospecting/engagement; Momentum captures calls/emails/meetings to CRM.
- Named Query API GA; Agent Builder API; Salesforce-hosted MCP servers GA; v67.0 security defaults.

## Prior (Spring '26, from 2026-03-25 fetch)
Agentforce Voice, Field Service proactive ops, Sales/Service/Marketing/Commerce/Platform.
